title: The Perfect Prayer
sentences: A condemned man recited the Lord’s Prayer perfectly on the gallows.
Many believed a witch could not say it without a mistake.
The man was George Burroughs, a former minister of Salem Village.
Accusers had called him the ringleader of the witches.
One account says his prayer drew tears, and the crowd nearly stopped the hanging.
It went ahead anyway, on August 19th, 1692.
He was the only minister executed in the Salem trials.
